Usage: eon agent retire NAME [--project P] [--bead ID] [--target-only] [--dry-run] [--json]
Guard: resolved cwd, executable, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, open-fd and mapped-file paths, plus cwd directory identity.
Unreadable details of owned processes keep files and exit 1, naming the PID.
The caller vouches that NAME and --bead identify the same finished task.
Bind-mount aliases of agent directories are unsupported and may not be detected.
